digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation system with relationship pinning and execution phase enforcement
propositions: Downstream plan-review attestations remain valid despite upstream plan material changes in direct children or prerequisites, allowing agents to close work under stale assumptions
New plan reviews must sign cryptographic pins recording each direct child and prerequisite's canonical ID, role, and current narrow material fingerprint to bind attestations to related ticket state

Material drift in a pinned related ticket invalidates the downstream attestation when pin enforcement is enabled, with natural propagation only through direct dependencies rather than eager graph-wide invalidation

Ticket execution phase is derived from process_status transitions (open/idea→planning, in_progress→execution, other statuses preserve phase) and stored in compiled state to bound execution-mode reviews to 0.80 priority-floor and block lower-priority findings

Close operation requires a compatible certified plan review when both require_plan_review_for_close and enforce_plan_material_pins are enabled, but code freshness alone cannot invalidate the close-profile review

Prerequisite consistency evaluation deterministically records one disposition per canonical prerequisite (consistent, finding, or indeterminate) in isolated LLM calls; indeterminate results yield unsigned reviews and any relationship unreadability aborts pre-sign collection
